rationale: Best-supported negative: the description concerns software and systems delivery and technologies intended to improve productivity, but remains broad and does not identify specific conventional software functions; the negative is therefore uncertain under the software-functionality requirement.
evidence_spans: IBM® Rational® provides a full range of offerings to ensure software and systems delivery success through practical, reliable, and extensible components.
Rational® offerings provide flexible, time-saving technologies that are developed for immediate productivity, high-fidelity results, and cost-savings.
conflict_response: Both proposals cite broad delivery/productivity claims rather than concrete functions. The text does situate the offerings in software and systems delivery, but does not say what the components do; I retain non_ai as the best binary judgment while marking it weak/forced rather than treating marketing language or missing AI words as supported software scope.
